title: BACE: Safety & Workplace Culture - Biotechnology - Chemical Segregation
subject: Biotechnology

questions.q: Which two classes of chemicals should **never** be stored together due to the risk of violent reaction?
questions.explain: Acids and Bases are incompatible; mixing them causes a neutralization reaction that is often exothermic (releases heat) and can cause splattering or explosion if concentrations are high. They must be stored in separate cabinets.
